subject: I don't mind translating mine Foxy
author: ichienkai
body:
To begin with i found Bootlegs words very funny when translated as they came back all jumbled up - the only part i understood was right at the end and it was the bit that had two words in close proximity to each other: "Bald" and "Homo".  We know Boot is fond of refering to me with those two very descriptive words,  thats why i cracked up at work and my boss nearly sacked me when he saw which website i was on!

My reply also contained the word homo - no disrespect to any homosexuals who are reading this, i am not homophobic and i don't reckon anybody should be: live and let live.  My last sentence tried to explain to Guippy why i was refering to Bootleg as a homo - namely because he races without his pants on.  Each to their own dude whatever! 

But when i managed to get a translation of that last bit it came back something like   "Bootleg's pants race on top of him"  thats why i cracked up at work for the second time, and thats why i am now gainfully unemployed clutching my P45 in my gnarled Burned out hands that i reckon are now only useful for pushing and pulling triggers on a frig*in 360 controller! Hahaha So Foxy i offered no disrespect towards Giuppy who has the ability to so often light up a Burnout room with his Italian incoherent madness.  In a way it is much like the fondness of your very own Japanese stalker who we know for a fact was very obsessive towards you with the content of his motto... but never spoke once over many many races.  I am done insulting Bootleg by the way - how long have we been racin' Boot??? And he never fails to make me laugh - probably because English is his second language and he never quite makes sense 😏 Much like his above blog post translated sssooo funny dude

Damn i'd better start job hunting!

Foxy i remembered that important thing we were talking about last night but i won't put it on here - I would'nt want to give Boot any more ammunition!!

 

 

 

----This Is The Working Hour: We Are Paid By Those Who Learn By Our Mistakes----
